title: hieracium carolinianum subsp. domingense
intro: Hieracium carolinianum subsp. domingense, commonly known as Mountain Hawkweed, is a species of flowering plant in the dandelion family, Asteraceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its purported health benefits, including treating wounds, reducing inflammation, and relieving pain. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium carolinianum subsp. domingense are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, sesquiterpenes, and triterpenoids, which have been shown to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. However, more research is needed to fully understand the effects and potential uses of this plant.
